children: Bonk entered into a Preferred Stock Redemption Agreement to repurchase 26,667 Series A Preferred shares from Core4 for $4.0 million, payable by wire within three business days. Following the transaction, Core4 will retain 73,333 Preferred shares and has irrevocably waived anti-dilution, voting, liquidation, and conversion rights tied to those shares, and provided a general release of claims. In the event of a merger, the remaining 73,333 Preferred shares would convert into 1,516,873 common shares. The move is intended to simplify Bonk's capital structure and reduce potential dilution.
